title: Basic experience is what a generative model of the sensorium is like

statements.text: Basic phenomenal consciousness is what it is like to be the functioning of a probabilistic generative model for the sensorium of an embodied and embedded agent, iteratively filling in likely system and world states from past experience.

sources.quote: Basic phenomenal consciousness is what it is like to be the functioning of a probabilistic generative model for the sensorium of an embodied–embedded agent.
iteratively estimating (or filling-in) data from likely systemworld states, given past experience
